briefdescription.para: Returns fractional area covered by ocean in a grid box.

simplesect.para: A logical value of true if the output field was successfully created. A value of false may be returned if the Navy 1/6 degree percent water data set was not readable.

parameterdescription.para: Longitude (radians) at grid box boundaries
Latitude (radians) at grid box boundaries
The fractional amount (0-1) of ocean in a grid box. The size must be size(blon)-1 by size(blat)-1

briefdescription.para: Returns a "realistic" mean surface height field.

detaileddescription.para: Returns realistic mountains on a latitude-longtude grid. The returned field is the mean topography for the given grid boxes. Computed using a conserving area-weighted interpolation. The current input data set is the 1/6 degree Navy mean topography.

simplesect.para: A logical value of true is returned if the surface height field was successfully created. A value of false may be returned if the input topography data set was not readable.

parameterdescription.para: is not equal to (/size(blon)-1,size(blat)-1/) Check the input grid size and output field size.
Longitude (radians) at grid box boundaries
Latitude (radians) at grid box boundaries
Mean surface height(meters). Size must be size(blon)-1 by size(blat)-1

briefdescription.para: Returns a standard deviation of higher resolution topography with the given model grid boxes.

detaileddescription.para: Returns the standard deviation of the "finer" input topography data set, currently the Navy 1/6 degree mean topography data, within the boundaries of the given input grid.

simplesect.para: A logical value of true if the output field was successfully created and false if the input topography data set was not readable.

parameterdescription.para: Longitude (radians) at grid box boundaries
Latitude (radians) at grid box boundaries
The standard deviation of surface height (in meters) within given input model grid boxes. Size must be size(blon)-1 by size(blat)-1
